name: aria2-download
title: Aria2 Download
description: One queue for direct URLs, torrents, magnet/BT, and netdisk links pushed by LinkSwift.
author: darkings

commands.name: tasks
commands.title: Aria2 Tasks
commands.subtitle: Aria2
commands.description: Show active, waiting, paused, completed and failed downloads.

commands.name: add-download
commands.title: Add Download
commands.subtitle: Aria2
commands.description: Queue URLs or magnet links, with advanced request headers.

commands.name: add-torrent
commands.title: Add Torrent
commands.subtitle: Aria2
commands.description: Queue a local .torrent file or the file selected in Explorer.

commands.name: configuration
commands.title: Aria2 Configuration
commands.subtitle: Aria2
commands.description: Edit aria2 HTTP, BT, RPC and notification settings.

commands.name: start
commands.title: Start Aria2
commands.subtitle: Aria2
commands.description: Start the aria2 RPC daemon in the background.

commands.name: stop
commands.title: Stop Aria2
commands.subtitle: Aria2
commands.description: Stop the aria2 RPC daemon when there are no active downloads.

preferences.name: rpcEndpoint
preferences.title: RPC Endpoint Override
preferences.description: Leave empty to read the endpoint from the engine settings. Only set this for a remote aria2 RPC.

preferences.name: rpcSecret
preferences.title: RPC Secret Override
preferences.description: Leave empty to read the secret from the engine state file. Only set this for a remote aria2 RPC.

preferences.name: autoStartDaemon
preferences.title: Auto-Start aria2
preferences.label: Start aria2 when a download command opens
preferences.description: Start the local RPC daemon if it is not already responding.

preferences.name: refreshInterval
preferences.title: Refresh Interval
preferences.description: How often the task list and task detail refresh while open.

preferences.name: chunkViz
preferences.title: Chunk View
preferences.description: Heatmap is the polished fixed-layout SVG card. Mosaic is the native Raycast color grid fallback.

preferences.name: chunkColumns
preferences.title: Fallback Chunk Columns
preferences.description: Used by the native mosaic fallback, and by the heatmap when its image cannot be rendered.

preferences.name: showStopped
preferences.title: Show Stopped Tasks
preferences.label: Show completed and failed tasks in the list
preferences.description: Turn off to keep the list focused on active and waiting tasks.

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build
